name: Ultimate Railroads

rounds.endCondition: After the scoring phase of round 7 (6 rounds with 2 players)

categories.label: Score track after round 7 scoring
categories.hint: Points scored at the end of each round plus immediate points gained during play.

categories.label: End bonus card points
categories.hint: Read the end bonus card(s) you hold (e.g. 4 per factory, 6 per hired engineer, 10 per end station). Sum all cards.

categories.label: Engineer majority (40 / 20 / 0)
categories.hint: Most engineers 40, second-most 20; players with none score 0. Tie: highest-numbered engineer wins the higher slot. Enter 40, 20 or 0.

tiebreakers.description: No tiebreaker; tied players share the victory.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Final scoring after round 7 covers only End Bonus Cards and Engineer Majority. A bonus card can count as an extra engineer for the majority. Per-round scoring (routes, industry track) is tracked on the score track and not itemised. 2-player game plays 6 rounds; 3-player differences not checked.

sources.title: Ultimate Railroads Rulebook (Garphill/Hall Games, via 1j1ju)
sources.section: End of the Game (p.22); End Bonus Cards (p.47)
